prompts.menu:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: production main-menu background for a high definition remaster of the Chinese Three Kingdoms RTS game 三国赤壁.
Input image 1 is the original menu background, a composition and historical mood reference.
Primary request: completely repaint this old low-resolution background into a coherent, crisp 2560x1440 landscape painting, fixing all rectangular splice seams and distorted objects. Preserve the nostalgia: dark red lacquered scholar's desk, an aged Chinese open book and loose paper in foreground, brush and inkstone on the left, elegant bronze incense vessel on the right. Historical late Han Chinese study. Painterly realistic game background with clearly defined wood grain, bronze patina and paper fibers, warm restrained light, dark reddish brown and muted antique gold palette. Upper third is a dark quiet backdrop with room for an actual game title rendered later in code. Center from 45% to 90% height has dark uncluttered wood with room for five menu buttons. Keep props primarily at lower corners and sides, do not place a vessel in the button area. One seamless continuous composition. Avoid photograph collage or rectangular patches. NO lettering, NO Chinese title, NO buttons, NO UI frames, NO readable writing, NO people, NO watermark. The open book may have tiny abstract ink strokes only. Full bleed opaque landscape background.
prompts.barracks:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: finished transparent isometric RTS building sprite, not a concept sheet.
Input image 1 is an old eight-cell sprite atlas. Use ONLY the first leftmost building as the design reference; ignore the second unfinished construction and all empty cells.
Primary request: faithfully repaint the first building, a Three Kingdoms infantry barracks, in high definition with clear restrained hand-painted realistic detail while keeping its original silhouette, elevated orthographic isometric view (2:1 ground diamond), front door location, and footprint. ONE complete building on a square transparent 1024x1024 canvas, centered, filling the canvas like the original first square cell, with about 3 percent transparent padding. Burgundy/maroon pyramidal two-tier cloth roof with cream piping and folds, ochre plaster walls, dark open front entrance on lower-left facing facade, weathered grey stone low boundary wall, attached timber weapons shed protruding to the lower-right foreground with gold straw-like slatted roof and stored spear shafts, one yellow square military banner on the right with blue circular emblem and BLUE cloth tassels to retain owner-2 recognition. Preserve the diamond base and brown earth only inside the existing base, soft compact baked shadow. Top-left light. Late Han Chinese military architecture, antique ochre, ivory, grey and muted maroon palette. Crisp readable silhouette and medium-size material shapes suitable for display at 88x88 world pixels. Not photorealistic miniature, no dramatic light, no depth of field.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha everywhere outside building and base; ONE building only; NO atlas; no checkerboard pixels; NO black/white rectangle; NO readable characters or text, no watermark, no ornate added towers; do not invent flags or change camera angle. This is a replacement for frame 0 only, with no animation.
prompts.residence:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: finished transparent isometric RTS building sprite.
Input image 1 is an eight-cell atlas from the old 三国赤壁 RTS. Use ONLY the FIRST leftmost completed cottage as the design reference. Ignore the ruined second cell and all empty cells.
Primary request: remaster the original neutral village residence with clean high-definition hand-painted material detail while faithfully preserving its layout and silhouette. ONE cottage asset on square transparent 1024x1024 canvas. Isometric orthographic elevated RTS view, ground diamond 2:1. Match the first square cell: a larger ochre clay house with pale golden thatched gable roof on left, attached lower small ochre room with thatched roof on right, dark brown main doorway visible on front-left facade, small dark square windows, golden low split-wood fence at front, compact grey stone enclosure behind/along the base, brown earth diamond and a small green patch inside the courtyard. Keep building lower in the frame with approximately the original top third empty to preserve the lower silhouette, bottom base just above lower edge, centered laterally. Late Han vernacular Chinese farmhouse. Same restrained antique ochre and grey palette with warm light from upper left. Clear readable shapes when displayed at 88x88 world pixels, consistent with an old classic RTS, painterly realistic not hyperreal photographic, no modern architectural elements.
Constraints: transparent alpha background, no ground outside the compact existing base, no checkerboard, no rectangle, no text, no watermark, no people, no banner or team-color cloth on this neutral cottage. ONE asset only, no sheet/grid, no construction stages. Preserve original camera and compact footprint.
